hints.title: Customer First Order Immediate Percentage
hints.text: Identify each customer first chronological order and calculate the percentage of those first orders that were immediate.

hints.title: Earliest Order Subquery Tuple Membership
hints.text: Filter delivery records matching customer minimum order dates, then compute the immediate delivery ratio.

hints.title: First Order Immediate Query Blueprint
hints.text: select round(100.0 * sum(case when order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) as immediate_percentage from Delivery where (customer_id, order_date) in (select customer_id, min(order_date) from Delivery group by customer_id).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage
FROM Delivery
WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date)
    FROM Delivery
    GROUP BY customer_id
);
```

complexity.notes: Finding customer first order dates followed by tuple filtering and conditional sum executes in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating across all orders rather than exclusively customer initial transactions produces invalid cohorts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Composite tuple IN subquery isolates earliest orders in a clean, indexable manner.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Isolating first order per customer using MIN(order_date) subquery or ROW_NUMBER().

WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage
FROM Delivery
WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date)
    FROM Delivery
    GROUP BY customer_id

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def immediate_food_delivery(delivery: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    idx = delivery.groupby('customer_id')['order_date'].idxmin()
    first_orders = delivery.loc[idx]
    immediate = (first_orders['order_date'] == first_orders['customer_pref_delivery_date']).sum()
    pct = round(100.0 * immediate / len(first_orders), 2)
    return pd.DataFrame({'immediate_percentage': [pct]})
solutions.approach: Pandas Groupby Idxmin for First Orders and Mean Ratio
